## About
Steve's Automotive is a local, family-owned auto repair shop in Portland. We look after our friends and neighbors throughout the Portland Metro area. We are not too big where you are forgotten. We've stayed just the right size to know you and your car's needs well.
We're a full-service maintenance and repair facility for both domestic and popular imported vehicles. Our technicians are ASE-certified, and we're an Oregon State Certified DEQ Repair Facility.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 112 reviews. A reviewer mentions Ed by name, saying he was able to talk them through what he found.

## Services
- Full-Service Automotive Maintenance and Repair: Maintenance and repair for your car, all under one roof.
- DEQ repair: We're an Oregon State Certified DEQ Repair Facility.
- Early morning shuttle: A one-way shuttle to downtown Portland in the early morning, by appointment.
- Rental cars through Enterprise: Need a car while yours is in the shop? We can set up a rental through Enterprise with prior arrangement.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you guarantee your work?
A: Yes. Personalized Professional Auto Care includes a guarantee on service and repairs.

Q: What payment do you accept?
A: We accept Visa, MasterCard, and debit cards.

Q: Can I book an appointment online?
A: Yes. Request an appointment online, pick the services you'd like, and one of our staff will contact you to confirm.
